description: Source code for the DSLHAL class implementing DSL hardware abstraction layer functions, including initialization, parameter get/set, and statistics retrieval, with external dependencies and C-style object creation/destruction.

classes.name: DSLHAL
classes.description: Class implementing DSL hardware abstraction layer functions for parameter management and statistics.

methods.name: testmodulepre_requisites
methods.description: Dummy function for registering TDK with the CR, returns 'SUCCESS'.

methods.name: testmodulepost_requisites
methods.description: Dummy function for unregistering TDK with the CR, returns TEST_SUCCESS.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Registers all the ble_hal methods, returns TEST_SUCCESS.

methods.name: DSLHAL_Init
methods.description: Initializes the DSL HAL using a configuration file, updates response with success or failure.

methods.name: DSLHAL_GetParamValue
methods.description: Retrieves a DSL parameter value via JSON HAL, updates response accordingly.

methods.name: DSLHAL_SetParamValue
methods.description: Sets a DSL parameter value via JSON HAL, updates response accordingly.

methods.name: DSLHAL_GetLineStats
methods.description: Retrieves DSL line statistics and populates response.

methods.name: DSLHAL_GetXRdk_Nlm
methods.description: Retrieves the NLM value of DSL line and updates response.

methods.name: DSLHAL_GetLineInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information of DSL line and updates response.

methods.name: DSLHAL_XtmGetLinkStats
methods.description: Retrieves XTM DSL line link statistics.

methods.name: CreateObject
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DSLHAL.
